official_definition: You can destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with two cores or more on it. Then, you can send a core from any of your "Hera" Grandwalker Nexus to this Spirit or the Trash. When you've done so, send two cores from the opposing Reserve to the Trash.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Curse Unleash] or [Curse Unleash: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Curse Unleash]", "give [Curse Unleash]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
